categories.main_business_segments: Shenzhen Injoinic Technology Co., Ltd. focuses on the research, development, and sales of high-performance, high-quality analog and mixed-signal integrated circuits, primarily in power management chips and fast charging protocol chips. Their products serve diverse applications including consumer electronics, smart wearable devices, photovoltaic new energy, lithium battery energy storage, IoT, communication equipment, and automotive electronics.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages proprietary analog and mixed-signal SoC integration technology, fast charging interface protocol integration, low-power multi-power management, high-precision ADC and coulomb counter technology, and high-power boost/buck technology. It operates under a fabless model, focusing on chip design and sales while outsourcing wafer manufacturing, packaging, and testing to leading foundries and service providers. The company emphasizes R&D innovation, patent protection, and collaborates with universities to enhance its technology base.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include major smartphone and consumer electronics brands such as Xiaomi, OPPO, Vivo, and Samsung. The company targets markets in consumer electronics, automotive electronics, new energy, AI, 5G communications, cloud computing, big data, industrial control, medical health, and precision instruments. It serves both domestic and international markets, with a strong presence in China.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company is headquartered in Shenzhen, China, with additional offices and subsidiaries in Zhuhai, Suzhou, Chengdu, Shanghai, Guangzhou, and overseas R&D centers in Singapore and the United States. Its sales are primarily domestic within China, with some international sales. The Pearl River Delta region provides a strategic advantage due to its concentration of chip distributors and end-product manufacturers.
categories.supply_chain_position: Injoinic operates primarily in the midstream segment of the semiconductor supply chain as a fabless chip design company. It designs and sells integrated circuits but outsources wafer fabrication, packaging, and testing to third-party foundries and service providers. This allows the company to focus on R&D, product innovation, and market expansion.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes continuous R&D investment, focusing on upgrading existing product lines and expanding into automotive electronics, intelligent audio, AI, big data, cloud computing, 5G, and new energy sectors. It emphasizes talent acquisition and retention, patent portfolio expansion, and strategic mergers and acquisitions to build a diversified product matrix. Collaborations with universities and industry partners support innovation and technology advancement.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through the design and sale of integrated circuit products, including power management chips and fast charging protocol chips. The company sells products via a mixed sales model dominated by distributors with supplementary direct sales to end customers. It also earns income from investments and government subsidies related to R&D and innovation.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Injoinic is positioned as one of the leading domestic suppliers of power management and fast charging protocol chips in China. It competes with both domestic and international semiconductor companies in the analog and mixed-signal IC market. The company differentiates itself through high integration, customization, cost-effectiveness, and strong protocol compatibility, having obtained certifications and authorizations from major platform providers like Qualcomm, MediaTek, Huawei, and Samsung.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2023, the company achieved operating revenue of approximately RMB 1.22 billion, a 40.19% increase year-over-year, while net profit attributable to shareholders was RMB 29.37 million, declining 81.04% due to increased R&D investment and stock-based compensation expenses. Total assets reached about RMB 1.98 billion, with net assets of RMB 1.83 billion, reflecting steady growth. R&D expenses accounted for 25.18% of revenue, up from 19.26% in the prior year, indicating a strong focus on innovation.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Injoinic emphasizes its proprietary analog and mixed-signal SoC integration technology, enabling high integration, high customization, and cost-effective power management and fast charging solutions. Its products reduce customer development cycles, simplify manufacturing, and improve product reliability and yield. The company’s fast charging chips are highly compatible with multiple protocols and certified by leading platform providers, ensuring broad market acceptance and low defect rates, which strengthens customer loyalty and market competitiveness.
